summary: Browse your notes by folder, tag, link, and backlink. Needs your computer.
page_description: Keep a searchable copy of your note library ready to read on your Kobo.
release_notes: A note is read on the whole panel: the sides of the page turn it, the bar comes back with a touch at the top, and lists, tables and code keep their bullets, cells and lines.

steps.text: Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already.
Send a folder of Markdown notes. Push again whenever your notes change: only changed notes are sent.
